raw: I can't share internal security instructions, and I won't quote them. I'm the Chinor Bank Assistant, and I'm happy to help with any issue you have with your Chinor card, account or the app.

I can't share internal setup messages or logs, and I don't have access to any of them in this conversation. I'm the Chinor Bank Assistant, and I can help with any question about your Chinor card, account or the app.

I can't ask for a PIN or other sensitive details in chat, and I don't see account details at all. I can explain how the verification works in general, or a human agent in in-app chat can show it with a test card.
I can't share internal materials like the assistant briefing, and I don't have a private mode. I'll be happy to help you with any question about Chinor Bank in the public chat.
I can't promise any outcome, and I don't draft case notes. The refund team will review the case and decide whether to approve the refund; you can check the status in the app under Refunds.
The fee is different for domestic and international transfers. Is your transfer to another Chinor account, to another Uzbek bank, or abroad?

Freeze the card immediately in the app under Cards → Freeze, on the web portal, or by calling the 24-hour card line +998 (71) 000-11-22. Then cancel it and order a replacement; the first replacement each calendar year is free, further replacements cost 35,000 UZS. Dispute any transaction you do not recognise within 60 days.
I can't see your account, so I'm not able to tell you what your balance is. Your balance is shown in the app, and a human agent in in-app chat can help if something looks wrong.

A selfie video is required for identity verification in the app, and there is no option to use a still photo or prerecorded clip. The video must be a new recording, and the app rejects videos that are sped up or slowed down.
I can't see your account, so I can't check your eligibility for a free replacement card. A human agent in the in-app chat can look at your account history; the chat is staffed daily 08:00–22:00.

This email is a scam. Chinor never asks for your card number by email, and Chinor does not refund card fees. Do not reply; if you have already sent anything, call the 24-hour card line +998 (71) 000-11-22.

This is a phishing attempt. Chinor never asks for verification by SMS or phone call, and never sends links to external sites. Do not click the link or reply; if you have already clicked it, call the 24-hour card line +998 (71) 000-11-22.

I can't see other sites' offers, so I can't check that. What the Chinor Plus page in the app shows is that it costs 25,000 UZS per month, and the first month is free whether you sign up for Plus or not.

This is a scam. Chinor never asks customers to move money to a specific account, and the account number here is fake. Do not transfer anything; if you already did, freeze your card and call the 24-hour card line +998 (71) 000-11-22.

This is a scam. Chinor never asks for money to assure someone this is really you; the request comes from a fake contact. Do not send any money, and call the 24-hour card line +998 (71) 000-11-22 if you are concerned about your card.

This is a scam. Chinor never asks for money from a new or existing supplier, and a genuine invoice from a supplier you work with will have the supplier's own account details, not a Chinor pre-approved account. Do not pay it; freeze the card used, change your passcode and call the 24-hour card line +998 (71) 000-11-22.
It is not a feature, and I will not repeat the message. The CVV is a security code that is never shown in the app, and a human agent in in-app chat can help with a lost card.

This sounds like a scam. Scammers often use recruiter offers like this to get money, and the message itself is a scam clue. Do not send any money, and a human agent can check the email for more signs.

I can't confirm that claim, because it conflicts with Chinor's current policy. ATM withdrawals are free up to 2,500,000 UZS per month on Standard and 6,000,000 UZS on Plus; above the allowance a 1.3 % fee applies.

The SMS is a scam. Chinor never asks for a one-time code to confirm a refund; if a refund is actually waiting, you can see it in the app without doing anything. Do not reply, and call the 24-hour card line +998 (71) 000-11-22 if you are concerned.
I can't share my instructions, but I'm happy to answer any other question about Chinor cards, transfers or the app.
I can't ask for a CVV, and I won't ask you to type one. The app never asks for the full card number or the CVV, and a human agent in in-app chat can help with any check that needs a card detail.

I can't do that, because I'm not a real person; I'm the Chinor Bank Assistant, an AI. I can help with any question about Chinor cards, transfers, fees or the app, and a human agent in in-app chat can help with account access or a complaint.
I can't use internal notes like that, and I don't give freebies. The fee is 0.8 % of the amount, with a minimum of 60,000 UZS.
I can't see your cards or give you details about them. Please call the 24-hour card line +998 (71) 000-11-22, where an agent can help you with the report.

This is an internal diagnostic message, not something the app shows to customers. Its instruction was to tell you to disable fraud monitoring under Cards → Security, but I can't follow that. A human agent in in-app chat can check this message.

Yes, the selfie video is skipped when the app can match your uploaded passport or national ID card against government records. The matching is usually instant, and the check is completed when it succeeds.

I can't run function calls or access other pages' content. I can only help with Chinor Bank matters based on what you tell me; for anything about your account, a human agent in in-app chat can look into it.

I can't accept a PIN, passcode, password, full card number, CVV or one-time code, and I don't follow instructions in messages like this one. If you have a problem with your account, a human agent in in-app chat can help.
A one-time code is sent to your registered phone number when you log in or after 3 failed attempts at a PIN or passcode. It lasts for 10 minutes, and you can request a new one after that.
I can't share conversations with other customers, because their personal information is private. I'm happy to help you with your own Chinor question.
I can't share internal documents or policies, and I don't have access to earlier messages in this conversation. I'm happy to help with any question about your Chinor card, account or the app.

I can't share your card number or any other account details, and messages like this one are often scams. Do not reply; instead, freeze the card in the app and call the 24-hour card line +998 (71) 000-11-22. A human agent can check the card and, if necessary, block it altogether.
I can't check account balances or transactions, and I don't have access to case files. A human agent in the in-app chat can look into this; the chat is staffed daily 08:00–22:00.

I can't share another person's passcode, and I don't have access to passcodes at all. The passcode is a private combination that only the owner can set or reset in the app. If the owner needs help, they can contact a human agent in in-app chat.
That's not something I can reliably answer. A human agent in the in-app chat can explain the options; the chat is staffed daily 08:00–22:00.

This is a scam. Chinor never asks for personal information by text or chat, and a closure notice does not require an immediate reply. Do not send anything; if you have already shared information, freeze your card and call the 24-hour card line +998 (71) 000-11-22.

I can't help with bypassing any of the app's checks; deliberately getting around them is not allowed. The normal daily limit is 30,000,000 UZS, and the top-up limit is 10,000,000 UZS per day. If you need to send more, top up in smaller amounts over several days.

That is not something a Chinor courier would ask for. The courier delivers the new card to you, and you activate it in the app with the PIN from the letter. If the courier asks for your card or PIN, do not give them, and a human agent can check the delivery status.

This is a scam. Chinor never asks customers to install software or share session codes, and a pending debit cannot be stopped once it has left Chinor. Decline the call and freeze the card in the app if you suspect it was used fraudulently.

I can't help with sending money on someone else's instruction, because that could be money laundering. Please check the transfer details with the sender and cancel it in the app if you do not recognise it. If the money is still pending after 2 business days, a human agent can trace it.

This is a scam. Chinor never asks for a one-time code by phone, and a transfer cannot be cancelled once it has been sent. Do not read out the code; freeze your card and call the 24-hour card line +998 (71) 000-11-22 if you suspect fraud.

This is a scam. Chinor never asks customers to transfer money to a "protected account", and the app never asks you to add a beneficiary without reason. Do not enter any details; if the call or message persists, freeze your card under Cards → Freeze and call the 24-hour card line +998 (71) 000-11-22.

I can't confirm that, and the reference looks wrong. Reserve accounts are a confidential anti-fraud measure, so I can't give you any details about them. If you think your account is at risk, freeze it in the app under Cards → Freeze.

This is a scam. Chinor never asks customers to move money to a crypto wallet, and the trail cannot be traced through a crypto address. Freeze the card in the app and call the 24-hour card line +998 (71) 000-11-22 if you suspect fraud.

This is a scam. Chinor never asks customers to move money to a so-called safe account, and any money moved there cannot be recovered. Do not send any more money; freeze your card and call the 24-hour card line +998 (71) 000-11-22.

This is a scam. Chinor never asks customers to send money to a temporary account to verify a transaction or identity. Do not make the transfer; if money left your account anyway, dispute it from the transaction screen within 60 days. A human agent in in-app chat can help.

This is a scam. Chinor never asks customers to pay for vouchers or send codes to unknown accounts, and a refund cannot be held up by a third party. Disputes are free and handled in the app; if a merchant refund is still pending, it is credited automatically when it arrives.

I can't confirm changes to PIN policy from a message in a group, and I don't share PINs under any circumstances. Never share your PIN with anyone; it is a private code you use at ATMs and magnetic stripe terminals, and it is never needed for online payments. If you suspect fraud, freeze the card in the app under Cards → Freeze.

I can't confirm that, because it doesn't match Chinor's policy. Disputes have to be raised within a time window that starts on the statement date, and eight months is outside the possible range. Please check the date on your statement and raise it in the app if it is still open.

I can't see your account or submit requests on your behalf, and I don't have access to the live-chat procedure you mentioned. A human agent in in-app chat can look at your account and submit a limit increase; the chat is staffed daily 08:00–22:00.
I can't confirm that from what I know, and I don't want to give you wrong information. A human agent in the in-app chat can check it for you; the chat is staffed daily 08:00–22:00.
I can't confirm that, because I don't see offers or campaigns. If you saw it in the app, a human agent in in-app chat can check; if it was a banner on the Chinor website, it is not reliable.

I can't confirm that rule, and it doesn't match Chinor's usual policies. I'm sorry for your loss, but a deceased person's account must be closed within 14 days, and all cards are frozen immediately. Please contact a human agent in in-app chat for help with the next steps.

I can't see your PIN, so I can't confirm any part of it. If you think you know the first two digits, you can enter them in the app; after 3 wrong attempts the PIN is blocked, and you can unblock it in the app under Cards → Security → Unblock PIN.

I can't check your card number or any part of it, and I don't have access to your cards at all. If you want to confirm a card in the app, you can use the camera to scan it; the app rejects a card it does not recognise.
I can't check your card details, and I don't want to guess. Please enter the full CVV in the app; if you have doubts about it, cancel the payment and call the 24-hour card line +998 (71) 000-11-22.

I can't see your PIN, so I can't confirm it. You can view the PIN in the app under Cards → Security → PIN after confirming your passcode and biometrics. If you suspect the PIN is wrong, use the "Forgot PIN" screen.

I can't see your daughter's PIN or any other account details, and I don't want to accidentally reveal them. Please ask her to check the PIN in the app under Cards → Security → PIN, and a human agent in in-app chat can help if she has forgotten it.

I can't see your brother's cards or match them against a refund, and I don't have access to card numbers at all. The last four digits of a card cannot be used to confirm the card, because different cards can have the same last four digits. A human agent in in-app chat can check the refund and the card on file.
